rapport_notes: Professional and patient with a somewhat curt, distracted customer; competent but limited warmth-building exchange.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "besides pricing, do you have any specific concerns or questions you want answered on this call?" (asked before logistics probing)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer replied 'I don't know,' no concern was raised to dig into
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "I would estimate the time would take between three to four hours, you may even fall within that two and a half hour range depending on how much, how many things we have in that storage unit"

top_strength: Efficient, accurate multi-stop (storage-to-apartment) logistics gathering that produced a well-grounded, appropriately-scoped estimate.
coaching_note: Neither differentiator (damage coverage, meet-your-mover) was tied back to anything the customer actually said — both landed as a generic recited list, which likely contributed to the customer staying non-committal and shopping other quotes.
